issue_context.title: Vulkan: GPUParticles3D attractor and collision Cull Mask doesn't have any effect
issue_context.body:
___

***Bugsquad note:** This issue has been confirmed several times already. No need to confirm it further.*

___

### Godot version

4.0.alpha8

### System information

Fedora 34, GeForce GTX 1080 (NVIDIA 510.60.02)

### Issue description

GPUParticles3D attractor and collision Cull Mask doesn't have any effect. I noticed this while working on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/60992.

The same issue occurs with GPUParticles3D collision nodes.

*Left: GPUParticles3D on layer 1, GPUParticlesAttractorBox3D with all cull mask layers enabled (default)*
*Middle: GPUParticles3D on layer 2, GPUParticlesAttractorBox3D with all cull mask layers disabled*
*Right: GPUParticles3D on layer 2, GPUParticlesAttractorBox3D with only the cull mask layer 2 enabled*

### Expected behavior

![2022-05-13_23 59 24](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/168395118-5eeec75d-7312-4cb2-a5fd-30a4264af9a6.png)

### Actual behavior

![2022-05-13_23 59 13](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/180032/168395116-733722b6-9223-4d48-ad62-6402749edf7b.png)

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a GPUParticles3D node, a draw pass and a process material to it. Set the emission shape to a sphere to you can see individual particles separated from each other.
- Add a GPUParticlesAttractor3DBox node.
- Enable only the second visual layer on the GPUParticles3D node.
- Set the cull mask to exclude all layers on the GPUParticlesAttractorBox3D node.
- To reproduce the same issue with collision, add GPUParticlesCollisionBox3D nodes and enable collision on the particles' Process Material.

### Minimal reproduction project

[test_particle_attractors_cull_mask.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8691548/test_particle_attractors_cull_mask.zip)

@GarrickWinter I suggest [testing](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/workflow/testing_pull_requests.html) https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91858 locally and see if it suits your needs :slightly_smiling_face:

review_comments: @akien-mga do we have a preference for including "core/typefs.h" rather than cstdint directly?

If the cull_mask of the particles_collision is updated, it looks like it won't be re-added to the particles' list of collisions. Is that correct? If so, there needs to be an associated check when updating the cull mask for collisions so that they can be added back.
That being said, ``particles_add_collision`` may get called when the ``cull_mask`` changes, can you confirm if it does?
I added an associative check that re-adds the collision and no particles_add_collision is not called during the `cull_mask` change.
